description: zizmor CI/nightly boot-and-test profile (req-plugin-extdev-repo-ci; consumed by tap's plugin-ci.yml boot-and-test job). Installs zizmor EDITABLE from the CI checkout at _external/zizmor so the in-package suite runs against THIS repo's HEAD, plus its declared dependency github_core and github_core's own dependency identity_core, both pinned by COMMIT (a tag can be moved; this profile makes code execute inside a job that holds TAP_CORE_RO_PAT). No population section yet: the plugin ships no GRIFT and no collector at this stage (skeleton, zizmor-tap#1). When req-zizmor-record lands, this record gains the corpus seed and a fire-collector step for zizmor:zizmor WITHOUT required_secrets — the offline collector needs none, which makes it the first boot-and-test record in the estate whose collector actually fires in CI. FIPS: the image runs FIPS-on by default and the pre-boot crypto-BOM gate scans the assembled venv — it found `boringssl` and `rust-aws-lc-rs` inside the zizmor binary on the first CI boot (2026-09-02) and refused to serve, exactly as designed; `fips_waivers` below is the OPERATOR's justified acceptance, narrowed to the two providers reviewed. NO profile_kind: it is an allowlist token that only ever widens, and a CI profile has no use for the dev_local affordance.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). github_core's declared dependency (oidc_issuer convergence node). Pinned to the commit v0.1.1 pointed at on 2026-08-28.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core). zizmor's declared depends_on: the workflow vocabulary (GithubWorkflow.configuration.raw_yaml, WorkflowJob) the collector reads and the edge endpoints it resolves. Pinned to the commit v0.4.0 pointed at on 2026-09-02. Installed, not seeded, not fired.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.zizmor), installed EDITABLE from the CI checkout so the in-package suite runs against this repo's HEAD. Pulls the exact zizmor==1.30.0 PyPI wheel (the scanner binary) as its Tier-0 dependency.

fips_waivers.reason: zizmor==1.30.0 is a static Rust binary that links ring (BoringSSL-derived core; the scanner reports it as `boringssl`) for TLS in its ONLINE audits. This plugin invokes `zizmor --offline` only (req-zizmor-collector), so the provider is present but never executes a security operation; the request path that would use it is never taken. Reviewed 2026-09-02 against zizmor's Cargo.lock (ring, aws-lc-rs/aws-lc-sys, rustls, reqwest). The wheel is built against the non-FIPS aws-lc-sys, so it is not the validated AWS-LC module even though that library is validatable; the day online audits ship (req-zizmor-online-audits) this waiver must be re-decided, not carried forward.
